lessons_used: Predictions were generally too optimistic overall, but underestimated gains on winning home wait_info tests.
Adding new screens at adoption (2 tests) or finish (2 tests) consistently hurt performance and caused early stops.
Home wait_info changes (12 tests) were helpful in four winning tests, though eight showed no clear effect.
Sign-in hints (2 tests), sign-in reordering (2 tests), finish copy changes (3 tests), finish layout changes (2 tests), and home redesigns (2 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin or inconsistent for categories with only one test or conflicting results across tests.

candidates.title: Desktop Render Status Feed
candidates.change: Add a live rendering activity feed component on the waiting screen to inform users of pet generation progress.
candidates.why: Home wait time has a high mean of 2336s and median 201s; previous wait_info additions on home showed strong retention gains.

guard.reason: Adding rendering progress indicators to the waiting screen is allowed and complies with all rules.

candidates.score_note: Home wait_info additions historically work well and beat baseline expectations.

candidates.title: Story Screen Journey Carousel Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the story intro screen to use a carousel layout highlighting companion desktop features prior to path selection.
candidates.why: Choose path step shows long mean duration (514s) and 20.6% drop-off; dynamic intro visuals increase intent.

story.headline: Discover Your New Desktop Companion
story.body: Explore interactive pet features that live directly on your screen while you work and play.

guard.reason: Redesigning the story screen with a carousel layout is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path redesigns showed +2.1% relative gains across 3 tests.

candidates.title: Post-Selection Account Auth Flow
candidates.change: Move sign-in screen to occur after pet selection and customization steps right before desktop launch waiting.
candidates.why: Sign-in currently drops 27.1% of users upfront before they experience pet customization; reordering leverages commitment.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in to after adoption is explicitly allowed under Rule 4 and retains all required steps.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in reordering consistently showed no clear effect in prior tests.

candidates.title: Pet Selection Stage Spotlight Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the friend picker screen with a spotlight layout highlighting pet personalities and traits.
candidates.why: Adoption stage drops 29.1% of users with high mean duration of 1017s; cleaner visual spotlight speeds selection.

pick_friend.headline: Choose Your Desktop Friend
pick_friend.body: Select the personality and visual style of your companion.

guard.reason: Redesigning the friend picker layout inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Adoption stage has 29.1% drop-off and redesigns yielded +3.3% relative gain.

candidates.title: Live Desktop Activity Timer Stream
candidates.change: Include a countdown timer and active tips delay display on the home waiting screen during pet rendering.
candidates.why: Long home wait times (median 201s, mean 2336s) cause anxiety; explicit timing info reduces drop-off.

waiting.hint: Preparing desktop shaders and interaction scripts...

guard.reason: Time estimates and progress hints during a real wait are allowed on the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Wait_info on home step addresses long wait times and consistently performs well.

candidates.title: Home Intro Spotlight Launch View
candidates.change: Redesign the final home intro screen using a spotlight layout showing essential desktop tray and visibility controls.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple emails regarding post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide the pet.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Ready on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Use the system tray icon or keyboard shortcuts to command, hide, or talk to your pet anytime.

guard.reason: Redesigning the home intro screen layout inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Support emails confirm issue, but past finish redesigns showed no positive impact.

candidates.title: Choose Path Stage Card Grid View
candidates.change: Reconfigure the choose_path screen into a stage layout with distinct visual option cards.
candidates.why: 20.6% of users drop off at choose_path with a median time of 8s but mean of 514s.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Journey Path
choose_path.body: Choose how you want to experience your companion on your desktop.

guard.reason: Updating the layout and copy of the choose path screen is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path layout changes previously degraded performance (-0.8%).

candidates.title: Photo Upload Stage Layout Overhaul
candidates.change: Change the photo upload screen layout to split view to clearly display pet reference images side-by-side with recommendations.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures and rendering issues.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Pet Photos
upload_photos.body: Provide clear photos for accurate desktop pet 3D generation.

guard.reason: Changing the photo upload screen layout to a split view is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Addresses support complaints; adoption layout had +2.3% gain but on 1 test only.

candidates.title: Desktop Control Keybindings Copy Focus
candidates.change: Update headline and body on the final home intro screen to explicitly explain pet tray controls and visibility shortcuts.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets specifically cited post-onboarding confusion over hiding and controlling the desktop pet.

home_intro.headline: Master Desktop Pet Controls
home_intro.body: Click the system tray pet icon to bring up controls, toggle visibility, or start conversation.

guard.reason: Updating home intro copy regarding desktop tray controls is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Config-only change targeting support tickets, but finish copy changes rarely move metrics.

candidates.title: Desktop Generation Progress Notification Stream
candidates.change: Enable desktop arrival notifications and progress tracking on the waiting screen to keep users informed during long setup.
candidates.why: Home conversion step drop-off and high mean waiting times (2336s) benefit from active setup progress notifications.

waiting.headline: Assembling Your Desktop Companion
waiting.body: Your pet is being configured and placed on your desktop background.

guard.reason: Enabling status notifications and progress tracking on the waiting screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Targets high home wait duration, though new flow changes carry mixed evidence.

lessons_next: Predictions were generally too optimistic overall, but underestimated gains on several winning home wait_info tests.
Adding new screens at adoption (2 tests) or finish (2 tests) consistently hurt performance and triggered early stops.
Redesigning the adoption stage (2 wins) and choose_path stage (2 wins) proved helpful, and home wait_info updates generated four wins despite many showing no clear effect.
Finish copy changes (4 tests), finish layout changes (2 tests), sign-in hints (2 tests), and home redesigns (2 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin for categories with only one test or conflicting non-significant results.
